ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  3i Infotech has submitted a compliance certificate for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, confirming to stock exchanges (BSE and NSE) that it received no requests for share dematerialization or rematerialization. This demonstrates full compliance with SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the period, indicating smooth administrative operations regarding share transfers and no backlog of such shareholder service requests. No red flags or material negative impacts are identified in this routine compliance filing.
